summary: Isolated-home integration and CLI tests proved install works outside a repository, creates one entrypoint for each selected agent, reports invocation/reload metadata, and creates no project state.
Migration fixtures removed marker-owned legacy skills while preserving unmanaged files, non-files, symbolic-link targets, and content outside the selected home.
Lifecycle runner tests verified npm global update occurs before the new empirical install process and package versus integration failures remain stage-specific.
Source and bundled CLI tests verified primary help exposes install/update only, README documents the one in-agent entrypoint, and MCP smoke retained all typed internal workflow operations.

Initialization fixtures verified safe configuration, runtime MCP bridges, repository context creation, and zero project-local workflow entrypoints; the generated skill carries material first-run configuration fields.

Knowledge tests verified deterministic byte-stable manifests, overview/architecture/commands/conventions pages, refresh on source change, topic preservation, secret exclusions, digest-only inventory, and packet context paths.

The installed-skill contract and integration tests verified initialization, context, resume-first behavior, five Socratic passes for ambiguity, strict Fast eligibility, Complex fallback, and no separate installed workflow skills.
Core handoff tests rejected pre-Specify use and verified the post-Specify offer contains current, save, and detected-agent choices without starting a process.

Agent fixtures distinguished prompt and workspace capabilities, asserted exact cwd/argv/prompt fields, required explicit approval, authorized unchanged tokens, rejected stale spec-bound tokens, and observed no launch side effect.

Real Git tests proved a linked worktree starts its intended feature when the committed base contains a blocked feature owned by the source checkout, while the source remains resumable and checkout claims do not collide.
Repeated install, initialization, knowledge refresh, schema migration, discovery, unmanaged-content, whitespace-preservation, symlink, and non-Git-to-Git fixtures all converged safely.

bun run ci passed: TypeScript check, 70 tests with 403 expectations, built CLI/MCP smoke including context and handoff, and npm dry-run for empirical-sdd@0.20.0 with 21 packaged files; git diff --check also passed.
